_meta.note: Statewide recurring events on the Michigan abolition calendar. Each entry represents an annual observance that Abolish Abortion Michigan calls its network to keep — typically prayer, lament, education, and/or peaceful witness. Local abolitionists host the observance in their own city (church, capitol steps, Signal group). Add specific rallies, hearings, or dated events here as they come up; anything present in this file is rendered on /events and emits full Event JSON-LD.
